Subject: Planned rolling restart for driver consolidation — opt-out & action items

Hi Maria / Storefront ops team,

Quick heads up: we’re scheduling a rolling restart across our US-West inference pools to deploy a consolidated kernel + NIC driver bundle (release 2026.09) that addresses a small class of long-tail memory fragmentation issues observed in mixed-tenant workloads. This is a targeted maintenance window — not a full outage — but I want to be explicit about possible spikes in tail latency for a few minutes during each host restart.

Window and scope:
- When: Saturday, 3 Oct 2026, 02:00–06:00 PT (US-West staggered approach).
- Which hosts: west-region inference pools running 2.x runtime (your dedicated pools tagged "sf-prod-west").
- Impact: each host will be drained, restarted, and brought back up; requests in flight will be re-routed and queued briefly. Typical per-host disruption: ~90–180s for redeploy + cache warmup for large models.

Why now:
- Consolidated driver reduces memory fragmentation and lowers cold-start variance for large-context chat tasks — measurable tail-latency improvement in internal benchmarks.

What we need from you:
1) If you want to opt a pool out of this window, please complete the attached opt-out CSV with pool IDs by EOD Thursday 1 Oct. We will exclude listed pools from the Saturday run and schedule a follow-up maintenance slot.
2) Confirm whether you run pinned model snapshots on any nodes in "sf-prod-west" (that prevents live migration); call that out in the CSV.
3) If SLA credit discussions are needed, flag that in the reply and I’ll loop in our finance team.

Attachments: driver-release-notes-2026-09.pdf (PDF, release notes); optout-window-form.csv (CSV: pool_id, owner, reason, contact).

Runbook & rollback:
- Runbook: https://redwood.app/runbooks/driver-consolidation-2026-09
- Quick rollback plan and telemetry: we will monitor 99th/99.9th latencies, KV cache hit, and error rates; automatic rollback to previous driver will be triggered if error-rate >0.5% sustained for 10 minutes for a region.

On-call and escalation:
- Primary on-call: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Secondary: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.com)

If you prefer a short sync to walk through this, happy to schedule 20 minutes. Otherwise, please send the opt-out CSV back by Thu EOD.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
